title: Data Mesh Learning interview: Nick Heudecker and Christian Romming
summary: Etleap streamlines data ingestion, transformation, and observability so your team can create data products effortlessly.
body_markdown:
Etleap CEO Christian Romming recently sat down with former Gartner analyst Nick Heudecker on the Data Mesh Learning program.


[Watch it on demand](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tmPYtWsqls8&t=1337s) **to hear them discuss:**


-


Product thinking around data and the associated organizational changes


-


The potential benefits of democratizing data


-


Deploying Etleap in a virtual private cloud (VPC)
